name: Grif Wildheart
summary: Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Grif Wildheart guides young hunters toward life with a beast companion. He teaches tracking, marksmanship, and how to tame beasts to hunters arriving from Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: A Life in the Wilds
sections.body: Grif Wildheart has spent his life in Dun Morogh’s frozen wilds. While many Ironforge dwarves choose the forge or the mines, local mountaineers say he spends too much time among four-legged beasts. Still, none question his command of the wild. Years spent tracking snowbound ridges with seasoned hunting companions have taught him the ways of the predators among the crags.

sections.title: The Way of the Beast
sections.body: Young dwarf hunters finish their first trials in Coldridge Valley, then travel to Kharanos for Grif’s guidance. He sharpens their aim and teaches them to survive in the wild. His deepest craft, though, is joining hunter and beast. He sends his pupils into Dun Morogh’s freezing wastes with a taming rod to face Large Crag Boars, Snow Leopards, and Ice Claw Bears.

sections.title: Journey to the Hall of Arms
sections.body: Once a hunter has calmed three kinds of wild beasts, Grif’s training in Kharanos is complete. A hunter must also learn to feed, discipline, and train a new companion. So Grif sends his graduates up the mountainside to Ironforge. Beneath the capital’s vaulted roofs, they report to master beast trainers and learn to care for a companion meant to stay with them for life.

faq.answer: Grif Wildheart trains hunters in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He guides novice Alliance hunters who have finished their first trials in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Where can I find Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: You can find Grif outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, along the snowy road from Coldridge Pass to Ironforge.

faq.q: What does Grif teach novice hunters?
faq.answer: Grif teaches young hunters to sharpen their aim, survive in the wild, and tame beasts. His lessons include wild boars, leopards, and bears.

faq.q: What beasts does Grif send hunters to tame?
aliases: which animals to tame dun morogh
faq.answer: Grif sends hunters into Dun Morogh to tame a Large Crag Boar, a Snow Leopard, and an Ice Claw Bear.

faq.q: Where does Grif send hunters after completing their taming trials?
faq.answer: After their taming trials, hunters go to Ironforge. There, advanced beast trainers teach them to feed and command their companions.

faq.q: What do the Ironforge mountaineers think of Grif?
faq.answer: Local Ironforge Mountaineers say Grif spends too much time with animals. Yet they readily admit he knows the hunter’s craft better than almost anyone.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to tame beasts from Grif and can bond with wild predators across Dun Morogh.
As a dwarf, you can follow Grif’s mountaineer tradition and live alongside wild mountain beasts.
As an Alliance scout or sharpshooter, you can learn from Grif in Kharanos and prepare for the wilderness around Ironforge.
